launch_ecs_instance: launch an ECS Fargate instance with a Docker container and environment variables for a Minecraft server
register_task_definition: register an ECS task definition with container image, port mappings, and logging configuration
request_instances: request and wait for multiple ECS instances to become available and return their IPs
allocate_instances: allocate ECS instances and register CloudFlare subdomains for each instance dashboard
free_ecs_instances: stop and free previously allocated ECS instances by their task ARNs
